limitations: Primary claim is lower minimap-refresh CPU cost; no isolated FPS gain is established.
Built-body count deltas are tolerated up to5 at both boundaries; exact rendered model membership was not attested.
Fresh user profiles retain warm OS and driver caches; one machine, shared host and synthetic offline500-creature workload.
Frame-work excludes cap sleep; delivered wall intervals include it; nested CPU/GPU timers must not be added.
Screenshots were captured after sampling; unequal hashes do not imply a regression and no automatic image-equivalence claim is made.
Godot memory values are snapshots; process RSS/HWM observations have their recorded sampling limits.
Actor-row microbench gains are component-only, not whole-collector or whole-frame qualification.
